author: andlo
name: NatoAlphabet
description: Spells words using the NATO phonetic alphabet (Alpha, Bravo, Charlie...) - 'spell Andreas' -> 'Alfa, November, Delta, Romeo, Echo, Alfa, Sierra'. Genuinely practical for dictating serial numbers, emails, or names over the phone. Pure text-to-table lookup, zero ambiguity, no external dependencies at all.
examples: how do you spell hello using the phonetic alphabet
